lines.text: You want to know what I'm thinking? Do you want to see for yourself?
Let me show you something fun.
Honey, can you use this to send a message for me?
I canceled all my plans to hang out with you. Wanna take a look?
For your eyes only. It's my deepest secret. ♡
I've saved every single message you sent me. See?
What are you up to, honey? I'm so bored... You're not going to leave me like this, are you?
I was a little upset that you were ignoring me, but now that you're actually here, I can't stay mad at you!

Whoa, the Outer Rim is a dump compared to here.
If this area is under my control...

Captain told me to bring you to Trendy Bar by any means necessary.
How about through seduction?

You are the owner of the Outpost, right?
This land will be in my possession if you belong to me.
Am I an eye-catching python, or a viper that can kill? That depends on you.
You want me to get stronger? Why?
That's just fine, thanks.
It's all on you if I end up spoiled.
These are for me? That's so sweet!
Gifts always delight.
That's nice of you, Honey♡

Don't let your guard down, Honey.
Nourishing a viper in your bosom is not a wise choice.
Do you mind going further with me?
I planned to make you fall head over heels for me, but it appears the opposite has happened.
You really want to have me by your side?
Hmm... Honey.
I'd rather not walk.
Wow, that thing's quite terrifying.
I'm trembling! Go to hell, scary monsters!
Hmmm... Too much shooting will make my arms sore.
Kill the goons over here!
Reloading♡
Hey, calm down.
No! My nail broke!
Honey ♪
Sending my love, ready for it?
Fire to the front!
One down♡
Going down!
Oh yay!
Annoying.
Ow!
Uh.
Sorry, Honey... I ran out of steam. Gonna take a break.
See? I made it! No enemies left standing.
Wouldn't it just be darling if we took some photos together?

Do I look good, Honey?
Hehe, if so, could you take a picture of me?

Honey, what do you think of my swimsuit?
I picked it out just for you!

Let's both set our phone backgrounds to that photo of us together!
What do you think?
Why don't we head to the ocean and make some secrets of our own?

This swimsuit isn't waterproof.
Would you like to see how it works?

Are you really going to leave me all alone like this, Honey?
My skin might get all burned.

You can't stop staring at me...
Have you finally fallen for me?
When you're done here, why don't you slip into your swimming trunks and we can have a pool date?

This is such a rare occasion, so I want to take lots of pictures with you!
Come a little closer, Honey!

Let's go on another date in our swimsuits, Honey!
When's the best time for you?
This summer, I want you all to myself, okay?♡
Are you sure about this? At this rate, I might gobble you up.
Thank you! Let's take one more picture to commemorate the occasion, okay?
Hmm... What's the intention behind all this care you're showing me?
Whoa, what a coincidence! I was going to give you a gift as well.
Oh wow, thank you! Let me take a photo and share it on social media.
Hehe, I bet the others are going to get so jealous.

You really have a knack for getting into a girl's heart.
At this rate, I might be in danger myself.
If you keep this up, I might just snatch you up and spirit you away.

That's another secret between just us.
Hehe, I like it!
You wanted to see me again, is that it?
Did you call me, Honey?
I wonder if there's a good spot around here to take a picture?
Honey, I'm scared!
I wouldn't want my swimsuit to get ruined.
Let's wrap this up and take some photos together.
We need to eliminate them for a better composition.
Wowzers, how scary♡
Reloading, la de dah♡
Just a minuuuuuute♡
Honey, can I start?
I'll devour all of you♡
This way, this way! ♡
Nighty night♡
Don't disturb me.
Sorry about having to do this♡
What?
Ugh.
Ugh.
Talk about spoiling the mood...
Now that that's over, let's take a photo to commemorate the occasion♡
What do you think, Honey? Doesn't this headset suit me perfectly?
Come here, Honey. I wanna color all over you ♡
Hehe! Listening to music and doodling like this makes me feel like a kid again.
Aren't you gonna ask me what I'm listening to, Honey? ... Wanna listen together?
I want to doodle my name all over your heart ♡ You don't mind, do you?
I'm your very own Viper kitty... Meow ♡
If you're going to leave me alone like this, then I'm going to doodle aaalll over the place.
Since you left me all alone, I guess this naughty little kitty will just have to mark your room as her territory ♡
Hehe! I wonder where I should doodle next... Oh, were you listening?
If I write my name right here, does that make this whole place mine? And if I write it on you, do you become mine, too?
Want to go for a walk together, Honey? We can listen to some good music along the way!
Meow ♡ My music led me here, and now you've got yourself a kitty. Take good care of me, will ya?
Oh my! Thank you ♡
Oh Honey, you've been working hard. Want me to compliment you?
If you keep treating me this well, I'm gonna start wanting more ♡
You shouldn't keep spoiling me like this... I prefer to take what I want, rather than have it given to me ♡
Oh, another thoughtful gift from my Honey ♡ Thank you.
Hehe, I'm going to write my name all over this. That way, no one can take it.
I want to paint you from head to toe in my own colors. That way, no one can steal you from me.
I'm a dangerous woman. If you keep being this nice to me, I might just eat you all up.
Oh, dear. I keep wanting you more and more... Can I write my name on you to make you mine?
Okay, hehe. I'm gonna listen to my music along the way, though.
Meow ♡
Anything to doodle on over there?
Oh my, looks like we've got a nuisance.
Think they'll let me doodle on them?
Let's get this over with so we can play, Honey.
Agh, I hope my outfit doesn't get ruined...
Ugh, this is taking forever...
Ooh, I can see your face from here!
Phew... My outfit's still okay.
Honey, I'm ready!
Wanna play? Meow ♡
Time to focus, everyone ♡
Good bye ♡
That's one down.
Hehe ♡
That hurts...
Ow!
Ugh.
Sorry, I'm tired. Time to call it a day.
How was it? Did that victory satisfy you?

favorite.name: First Phone and Phone Book
favorite.description: There was a time when we looked forward to getting calls. Because we had so many contacts saved, we had to bring our phone book around to remember everyone's number. It was a lovely time, wasn't it?
